applyTo: "src/i18n/**"
---

# Estexis Frontend i18n Instructions

Follow the canonical guidance in `.claude/skills/estexis-frontend-i18n/SKILL.md`.

- Add every new or changed key to all four dictionaries (`en.js`, `de.js`, `ar.js`, `bn.js`) in the same change.
- Use `formatCurrency()`/`formatDate()`/`formatNumber()` from `useTranslation()` for locale-sensitive values.
- Never hardcode a language code in component logic or override `document.documentElement.dir` manually.
